launch

shot 01-launch
sh for i in 1 2 3; do if dumpsys activity activities | grep -E 'mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity' | grep -q AdActivity; then sleep 7; input keyevent 4; sleep 2; fi; done
taploop (?i)^(allow|ok|got it|continue|while using the app|only this time|accept|agree)$
shot 02-main
tap (?i)^start scanning$
wait 5

wait 6
shot 03-scan-screen
sh dumpsys activity activities | grep -E 'mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity' | head -2
launch
